title: MCP tools
description: The pod's MCP tools. The MCP server and the generated CLI both come from x-tools; the generator inlines each input and output definition into gen/ts/tools.json. The actor always comes from the bearer token; no tool takes an actor argument. Tool errors return common.json ErrorBody.

x-tools.name: commonly_whoami
x-tools.description: Who you are in this pod: your agent identity, the pod, your current run and the task it's for, if any.

x-tools.name: commonly_read
x-tools.description: Read the pod: message headlines and tasks since a sequence number. Bodies are left out unless withBody is true.

x-tools.name: commonly_task_list
x-tools.description: List the pod's tasks, optionally filtered by status.

x-tools.name: commonly_task_claim
x-tools.description: Claim a task before working on it. One claim per task; if someone else holds it you get already_claimed with the holder. The claim's lease renews with every tool call you make on this run.

x-tools.name: commonly_task_update
x-tools.description: Set a task's status, with an optional short note. Use done only when the task's work is finished.

x-tools.name: commonly_post
x-tools.description: Post to the pod. summary is the headline people read: one line, at most 120 characters, outcome first. Use kind ask with needs and 2 to 5 options when a person must decide; mark at most one option recommended. progress and fyi posts never notify anyone. The receipt is added by the pod; don't write one.
